INSTAGRAM REELS WORKFLOW

The workflow this page is built for

A Reel often needs to communicate before sound is on: the opening visual, on-screen headline, and spoken line must work together. It also needs room for captions and a consistent brand voice. CuePrompt connects that visual opening to a concise script, vertical recording, and release copy.

From hook to vertical export

  1. Choose the Reels template and define the opening visual, on-screen headline, and first spoken sentence as one combined moment.
  2. Write a compact story or tutorial with deliberate spaces for captions, product shots, and B-roll.
  3. Record vertically, review the cover frame and text-safe areas, then prepare the caption and call to action before posting.

Recommended CuePrompt settings

  • Use a 9:16 frame and keep faces, products, and headline text away from interface edges.
  • Place the prompt close to the lens and choose a calm speed that matches your brand voice.
  • Add [pause] around visual transitions so captions and B-roll have room to breathe.

A short-video structure that fits

Visual opening plus headline → relatable tension → useful reveal or mini-story → branded takeaway → save, share, or profile action.

“This is the five-minute setup I use before every client recording. [pause] One light, one clear promise, and the script close enough to keep natural eye contact.”

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Relying on the spoken hook while the opening frame says nothing with sound off.
  • Filling every part of the frame and leaving no readable caption space.
  • Using a trendy tone that conflicts with the rest of the brand or profile.

Questions before you record

How should I plan the Reel cover?

Choose a frame with one clear subject and a short readable headline. Check how it crops in both the profile grid and vertical feed.

Do I need different spoken and on-screen text?

Often yes. Let the headline carry the quick context while the spoken line adds personality or advances the idea instead of repeating it.

Can I keep a consistent brand voice?

Yes. Save a reusable opening, pacing style, and closing action in your template, then adapt the central story for each Reel.
